description: Use the optional CodeGraph bridge automatically during task context compilation, while preserving bounded lexical fallback and validating all provider paths.
acceptance_criteria: Task context compilation queries CodeGraph when graph_backend is auto or codegraph.
Validated CodeGraph paths influence context ranking without bypassing repository exclusions or byte/token/file limits.
Missing, failing, malformed or unsafe CodeGraph output falls back to the existing lexical context path without leaking provider output.
Deterministic tests cover ready, unavailable, malformed and unsafe provider results.
Existing context graph and context compiler contracts remain compatible.
